content.text: {"id": "mm6942a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Coverage estimates for children born in 2016 and 2017 were compared with corresponding estimates for children born in 2014 and 2015."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Only 1.2% of children had received no vaccinations by age 24 months."}]}, {"v": "event-time", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Kaplan-Meier (time to event) analysis was used to estimate vaccination coverage for most vaccines by age 24 months"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "National coverage by age 24 months was ≥90% for ≥3 doses of poliovirus vaccine"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Differences in coverage between uninsured children and those with private insurance ranged from 9.5 percentage points (≥3 HepB)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The NIS-Child is conducted annually as a random-digit–dialed telephone survey"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "For most ACIP-recommended childhood vaccines, coverage was stable by year of birth from 2011 to 2017."}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC monitors coverage with ACIP-recommended vaccines through the National Immunization Survey-Child"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Differences were evaluated using t-tests on weighted data; p-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Kaplan-Meier (time to event) analysis was used to estimate vaccination coverage for most vaccines by age 24 months"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "** Statistically significant (p<0.05) difference compared with the referent group."}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "Statistically significantly different from zero at p<0.05."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types", "analytic_depth"]}
